terms.cn: Legal theory; the principles by which legal rulings are derived from evidence.
Command; in usul, a speech act requesting an act.
Prohibition; in usul, a speech act requesting omission of an act.
General; a term covering many instances without restriction.
Specific; a term restricted to some instances rather than all.
Signification; how a text indicates meaning.
Scholarly disagreement; difference of opinion among scholars.
Original source or base; here likely the primary text or foundational reference.
